title: Answer questions about a log
setup:
cat > access.log <<'LOG'
09:00 INFO alice
09:02 ERROR bob
09:05 INFO carol
09:07 ERROR alice
09:09 WARN dave
09:12 ERROR bob
09:15 INFO alice
09:18 ERROR erin
09:20 INFO bob
09:21 ERROR carol
LOG

checks.name: errors.txt holds exactly the ERROR lines
checks.stdout:
09:02 ERROR bob
09:07 ERROR alice
09:12 ERROR bob
09:18 ERROR erin
09:21 ERROR carol

checks.name: error-count.txt holds the number of ERROR lines
users.txt lists each user once, sorted

hints: grep ERROR access.log prints the matching lines. Add > errors.txt to save them.
Pipe into wc -l to count lines.
cut -d' ' -f3 takes the third field. Then sort, then uniq.
